image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a wet, rocky substrate. The left side of the frame is dominated by the chiton's dorsal surface, showing a series of overlapping, textured calcareous plates embedded in a leathery girdle. The right side shows the surrounding environment: wet pebbles, small shells, and algae-covered rocks, with water reflections indicating a tidal or intertidal zone.
